name: Dial M for ̶m̶u̶r̶d̶e̶r̶ Mayor
source:
Murder mystery visual novel: When Mayor Sokolov's son is found dead in his car, you must play the role of Detective Tashi and catch the culprit by interrogating suspects and taking risks.

[From [url=https://httpwhalien.itch.io/dial-m-for-mayor] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
谋杀推理视觉小说：索科洛夫市长的儿子被发现死在车里，你必须扮演塔希警探，通过审问嫌疑人并冒险调查，抓住凶手。

（来源：[url=https://httpwhalien.itch.io/dial-m-for-mayor]itch.io[/url]）
